name: Arr Profile Switcher
overview: Lets any Jellyfin user switch a movie's or show's Radarr/Sonarr quality profile and trigger a search, from an admin-curated list of options.
description: Adds a quality-profile picker to the item detail page and three-dot menu in Jellyfin Web. Users pick from a set of profile options an admin has curated per Radarr/Sonarr instance (e.g. 1080p / 4K); the plugin resolves the item to its Radarr/Sonarr record server-side, applies the chosen profile, and triggers a search. Radarr/Sonarr API keys never leave the server.
changelog: 1.0.0.0 - Initial release. Admin-curated profile-option mapping, GET /ArrProfileSwitcher/Status and POST /ArrProfileSwitcher/Upgrade, File Transformation-based client script injection.
